'''Juren''' served as the [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']], under the command [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Juren was ordered by Kolaff to set the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] after the vessel had come [[Attack on the Subjugator|under heavy fire]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Task Force Starfall]].
